headline: Microsoft unveils MAI models and agent tools at Ignite
source: Axios and Microsoft, via The Neuron
pages: Microsoft announced seven new MAI models at its Ignite conference this week, along with updates to Agent 365, its tool for managing AI agents inside companies. Among them are MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash, coding models built for complex development work and quicker, cheaper routine fixes. A roundup from explainx.ai also listed new Agent 365 analytics and cost-management features and said an always-on assistant called Copilot Autopilot began rolling out to select customers on Tuesday with human approval guardrails. That detail came from a single aggregator.

The launches matter because Microsoft is building its own models alongside its partnership with OpenAI, giving it more control over cost and capability in its business products.
Source: Axios and Microsoft, via The Neuron
